amendment_policy: Amendments may touch only non-outcome-affecting fields: artifact naming, prose clarification, added
diagnostics, added denominators, and corrections of citation.
No direction, sign, family member, arm, calibration, scale choice, missing-value rule, cohort, split
fraction, cold minimum, generalization threshold, admitted-fraction band, derived fit floor, binomial
alpha, anti-fiat guard or decision-procedure step may be changed by any amendment.
This plan adds four items to that list, each of which is a new degree of freedom it introduced and must
therefore bind itself on: estimation_cap, both effective-component floors, the direction registration
ladder, and which arm carries the verdict. None may be changed by amendment, and none may be changed
after a number computed under it has been read.
Anything in those lists can change only by a new pre-registration under a new plan_sha256, sealed before
the next number is read -- the same clause v1 and v2 carried and under which this file was authored.
v2's bound is carried forward and extended by one. A FOURTH pre-registration MAY NOT move the
admitted-fraction bands, the generalization threshold of 1.5, the split minimum of 400, the holdout
minimum of 40 or the derived fit floor of 0.10 downward, and MAY NOT raise estimation_cap or lower either
effective-component floor in order to recover rows after a failure. Those numbers have now survived three
plans and two recorded negative results. A plan that needs them looser is not a better plan; it is the
p-hacking these files exist to prevent, arriving by instalments.
Every amendment is appended to $.amendments naming the phase it preceded. $.amendments is outside
plan_sha256_over by construction, which is exactly why the binding policy lives here, inside the hash.

all_four_are_computed_on_the_capped_esti: Every quantity these four guards test -- holdout_cold_lift, holdout_cold_auc, both ablation margins, the
warm precisions and K, the overall and cold admitted fractions on all three splits -- is computed on the
component-capped estimation row set at estimation_cap, per component_aware_estimation. The uncapped and
component-equalized readings of each are published beside them and carry no verdict.
This is the clause that answers the HALT's demand in full: the component discipline is applied to every
statistic that carries a verdict, not only to the direction check.
Guard (b)'s ablation shares the capped set with the registered shape, exactly as it already shares the
denominator and the sealed tables, so the two shapes differ in one term and in nothing else.
Guard (c)'s K is a count of capped warm rows the FROZEN scorer admits. Its K < 20 fallback is unchanged and
is now more likely to fire, because the capped warm cohort is smaller; that is a tightening, and the fallback
condition it falls back to -- revised_warm_lift >= 1.0 -- is unchanged.

guard_a_generalization.computed_on: the component-capped holdout estimation set, inside the single pass

guard_b_family_ablation.ablation_threshold_rule: t_ablation is the HIGHEST threshold at which the ablation admits at least as many cold coldstart_train rows as the registered shape admits. Deterministic, always exists, label-free, and volume-matched on train. Where the achievable counts are coarse, the tie is broken toward the higher threshold -- fewer admitted rows, which raises the ablation's precision and therefore makes it HARDER for the registered shape to beat. The conservative direction is chosen on purpose.
conditions: holdout_cold_lift(registered) > holdout_cold_lift(ablation), STRICTLY. A tie is a FAIL.

holdout_cold_auc(registered) > holdout_cold_auc(ablation), STRICTLY, where cold AUC is the probability that a randomly chosen consumed cold holdout candidate scores above a randomly chosen non-consumed one, ties counted as one half.
mandatory_reporting: the ablation's own admitted counts and fractions on train, eval and holdout

if the ablation ALONE clears 1.5, that must be recorded as an explicit finding -- the guard still binds on the strict comparison, but a reader is entitled to know that the shape change carries a passing lift without the family
guard_b_family_ablation.sealed_with_the_parameters: t_ablation is fitted on coldstart_train and written into the sealed parameter digest before the holdout is opened, exactly like the registered threshold
guard_b_family_ablation.what_the_ablation_is: the SAME registered shape with the family arm replaced by its neutral value: S_ablation = N + 0.0. Same calibration tables, same rows, same fail-closed rules -- family_unscoreable rows remain inadmissible in BOTH shapes, so the two share a denominator and differ only in whether F contributes its real rank-normal value or 0.0.
why_auc_as_well_as_lift: Lift is measured at a threshold, so an ablation that lands at a very different admitted
volume can post a flattering or a punishing lift for reasons that have nothing to do with
the family. AUC is threshold-free and volume-free and cannot be distorted that way.
Requiring BOTH strictly is strictly harder than requiring lift alone. It is added, not
substituted, so guard (a)'s and this guard's stated form are both honoured.
why_this_ablation_is_not_a_strawman: On the cold subpopulation S_ablation is nearly constant: every cold row with a readable
ledger shares one history atom, so the ablation's only remaining discrimination among cold
rows is the level arm. The ablation therefore measures exactly the right thing -- whether
the family beats simply preferring schema nodes -- and 'prefer schema' is a real and
tempting degenerate policy, not an invented one.
It is also the precise control for the accusation this plan invites: the ablation IS the
imputation-and-recalibration fix with no family in it. If recalibration alone carried the
result, the ablation would match the registered shape and this guard would fail.

why_these_two_numbers: Both are transports of a bar that is ALREADY registered, not new inventions. The manifest registers
one_cluster_bar at split.one_cluster_bar.limit = 0.25: no single component may hold more than a quarter
of a split. The identity that connects the two is elementary -- if the largest share is s then
sum_c s_c^2 >= s^2, so effective_components <= 1/s^2, and therefore effective_components >= E implies
E >= 16 is therefore EXACTLY the 0.25 bar restated on an effective-count scale, and it is what the cold
subpopulation floor is set to: the cold cohort must satisfy on its own the bar the whole split already
E >= 100 implies s <= 0.10, a strict TIGHTENING of the same bar, and it is what the whole-split floor is
set to. It is set higher than 16 there because the whole split is what the binomial guard, the admitted
fraction bands and the lift are computed on, and 16 units cannot carry a p-value at alpha 0.05: the
finest tail probability 16 exchangeable units can resolve is coarser than the threshold the guard tests
against. 100 leaves a factor of five.
Adding a minimum is a tightening and is permitted by v2's amendment_policy. It is also the condition v2
lacked: v2's step 2 verified the 400-cold minimum, pairwise disjointness and the blindness invariant,
all three of which PASSED, and had no clause at all about how many independent units a split contained.
Under this floor, v2 would have halted at step 2 with train at 2.78 and eval at 4.18 -- before a single
direction was read, and therefore before any sign could be seen and re-argued.

why_largest_subject_to_the_floor: The floor is where independence is bought. Below it a verdict statistic is a statement about too few
units; at or above it the marginal component bought by a smaller cap buys nothing the verdict needs.
Past the floor a smaller cap only drops rows, and dropped rows are lost power on the two quantities
this plan is thinnest on -- the 40-admitted-cold-row minimum on the holdout and the exact binomial.
Stating the rule as floor-first-then-maximise-rows also fixes the order of the two considerations in
advance, so the cap cannot be re-argued later from whichever consideration is then convenient.

mandatory_three_arm_reporting.no_verdict_may_rest_on_the_reported_arms: the uncapped and component-equalized arms are published and are never a gate, in either direction. They may not rescue a failing capped verdict and they may not overturn a passing one.
mandatory_three_arm_reporting.rule: every statistic in what_carries_a_verdict_and_is_therefore_capped must be published in three arms: CAPPED at estimation_cap (verdict-bearing), UNCAPPED (reported), and COMPONENT_EQUALIZED (reported).
why: A capped verdict that the uncapped and component-equalized readings both contradict is a fact a reader
is entitled to have without re-running anything. Publishing all three costs one pass and removes the
possibility of a later plan discovering a disagreement and presenting it as new evidence.
It is also the audit trail for this plan's own claim: v2's numbers ARE the uncapped arm, so the
uncapped column of every table this fit produces is directly comparable to the recorded HALT.

component_aware_estimation.principle: no statistic that carries a verdict is computed on a raw split. Every one of them is computed on the component-capped estimation row set defined below, drawn once per cohort and then held fixed for every statistic computed on that cohort.

the_estimation_rule.caps_nest: the order does not depend on the cap, so the survivors at 25 are a subset of the survivors at 50 and so on up the grid. This matters here: it means the cap grid is a nested family and the arm table below is a sequence of nested subsamples, not six unrelated draws.
the_estimation_rule.drawn_once_per_cohort: the capped set is computed once for a cohort, from the cohort's full row list, and every statistic on that cohort -- overall, cold, warm, admitted, ablation, per era, per level -- is a subset of it. Re-drawing the cap per statistic, or capping the cold subpopulation separately from the whole tail, is FORBIDDEN: it would reintroduce as a per-statistic degree of freedom exactly what the cap exists to remove.

why_a_cap_and_not_component_equalized_we.component_equalized_is_not_discarded: it remains a MANDATORY published arm on every verdict-carrying statistic, beside the capped one and beside the uncapped one. It is a diagnostic here, not the estimator, and a verdict-carrying statistic whose capped and component-equalized readings disagree in sign must be reported as such.
reasons_the_cap_is_registered_instead: (1) THE BINOMIAL. verdict_rule.companion_conditions.binomial_guard is an EXACT one-sided binomial on
integer counts. Under fractional component-equalizing weights there are no integer counts and no
exact test -- one would have to invent an effective-n and round, which is a new fitted quantity
smuggled into a guard. Under a cap the counts are counts of real rows and the exact test is exact.
The goal this plan answers names precisely this: a binomial p over rows that are effectively three
clusters is not a p-value. A binomial p over a fractional pseudo-count is not one either.
(2) THE INTEGER MINIMA. 400 cold candidates per split, 40 consumed cold rows for a direction check,
40 admitted cold rows on the holdout, K >= 20 for guard (c): four registered minima that are
counts of rows. Under weights each of them would have to be re-read as a weighted count, which is
a change to a protected number by reinterpretation. Under a cap they mean exactly what they said.
(3) WHERE THE WEIGHT GOES. Equalizing components multiplies the weight of a one-row component by C and
divides the 7384-row component by 7384. It buys independence by moving almost all the mass onto the
least-observed units. That is a variance trade the published numbers show: train's cold effective
sample size falls to 494.35 of 2506 cold rows,
eval's to 258.06 of 927, the holdout's to
272.8 of 710. A cap at 50 leaves the retained
rows unweighted, so the estimator has no weight-induced variance at all.
(4) DISJOINTNESS IS UNTOUCHED EITHER WAY, and the manifest says so at
enlargement.concentration_cost.an_intra_split_cap_does_not_weaken_disjointness: the guarantee comes
from assigning WHOLE components to splits, and capping usage inside the split a component was
already assigned to puts no cache key and no session id into a second split.

decision_procedure: 1. Verify this file's plan_sha256 over plan_sha256_over, by the construction at seal_note. Any mismatch: HALT before reading anything. Record the verified hash in the revised policy.

2. Verify the splits WITHOUT READING A ROW, from dataset-manifest.json#coldstart alone: each split's capped cold-candidate count at estimation_cap is >= minimum_cold_candidates_per_split (400); the three component lists are pairwise disjoint; the published assignment satisfies split_protocol.assignment_rule.blindness_invariant_binding and reproduces its membership digests; and each split's capped effective_components at estimation_cap is >= effective_component_floor.whole_split (100). Any failure: HALT. Do not proceed on a smaller split, a different cap or a lower floor.

3. Read coldstart_train ONLY. Fit every rank calibration table on ALL of coldstart_train, uncapped. Draw the capped estimation set once, by the published cap rule at estimation_cap, and hold it fixed. Compute and PUBLISH each core member's direction reading -- whole tail and cold -- in all three arms and per era. Verify each published reading reproduces the value registered at direction_constraint.registered_directions[*].measurement within direction_constraint.train_check_is_non_evidentiary.tolerance; a mismatch is a HALT. Verify the cold effective-component floor (16) on train. THE TRAIN DIRECTION CHECK IS NOT A GATE: a registered sign that does not match its own train reading is published, not failed, and the six such readings already known are listed at direction_constraint.expected_train_readings.

4. Select the registered threshold and t_ablation by their registered label-free rules, using CAPPED coldstart_train admitted fractions. Publish feasible_threshold_count on coldstart_train in all three arms. If the capped count is 0: HALT and record a NEGATIVE RESULT; the holdout is not opened. Otherwise write the sealed parameter digest to disk before anything else is read.

5. Read coldstart_eval and secondary_anchor. On the capped estimation set of each, verify every core member's REGISTERED SIGN on the whole tail and on the cold subpopulation, evaluated separately. A member failing either, on either cohort, is a FAIL. A cohort below the cold_subpopulation_clause minima is INDETERMINATE for that member, which BLOCKS and never passes. Verify the cold effective-component floor (16) on eval. Publish the per-era decomposition and run era_exchangeability.simpson_guard, reporting it as vacuous where fewer than two eras are measurable. Any FAIL: HALT and record a NEGATIVE RESULT; the holdout is not opened.

6. Check guard (d) on the capped coldstart_train and capped coldstart_eval, and guard (c) on capped coldstart_eval. Publish feasible_threshold_count on coldstart_eval in all three arms. Any failure: HALT and record a NEGATIVE RESULT; the holdout is not opened.

7. Read coldstart_holdout EXACTLY ONCE, in the single pass specified at single_holdout_pass. Draw its capped estimation set inside that pass, before any statistic, and hold it fixed. Compute every quantity the pass lists, in all three arms and per era, including the holdout's capped effective_components whole and cold.

8. PASS requires ALL of, every quantity on the capped estimation set: guard (a) holdout_cold_lift >= 1.5; guard (b) both strict comparisons against the ablation, lift and AUC; guard (c) already cleared at step 6; guard (d) on every split including the holdout; admitted cold holdout count >= 40 and > 0; exact one-sided binomial p <= 0.05; holdout capped effective_components >= 100 whole split and >= 16 cold; every core member's registered sign already held at step 5; and the withheld-holdout reproduction returning a byte-identical parameter digest.

9. Any other outcome is a recorded FAIL or NEGATIVE RESULT. Neither may be repaired by widening the family, re-signing a member, adding a branch, re-drawing a split, moving a band or a minimum, CHANGING estimation_cap, CHANGING either effective-component floor, switching the verdict onto a reported arm, or re-reading the holdout. A fourth pre-registration that needs any of the five protected numbers lower is not a better plan and must record that finding instead.

defect_being_repaired.carried_from_v2: unchanged. The defect this family repairs is the same arithmetic-scale defect v2 diagnosed; nothing about it moved when the population was enlarged.
mechanism: src/living_memory/recall_map.py:1190-1258. relevance_score sums five z-terms. Feature 0 is
level_is_schema; features 1..4 are matured-history terms. When history is unavailable
_history_features returns RELEVANCE_FEATURE_MEANS[1..4] verbatim, so those four terms are
identically zero and the score collapses to the level term alone.
Those means are a FOREIGN COHORT's raw means: they were computed on the warm ledger
organic-tail fit cohort, every member of which had history. Substituting them into a
cold-inclusive population is not a neutral act, and that is the whole defect.

what_the_defect_actually_is.diagnosis: arithmetic SCALE, not signal, and not imputation

reading: A cold row must make up 5.6238 of history z using a family arm whose entire
median-to-p95 range is 0.9108. The handicap is 6.17 TIMES the family's ordinary
dynamic range. No threshold can arbitrate between two quantities that differ by
that factor: the ordering of the pooled population is the ordering by history
alone, up to a rounding error contributed by the family.

why_the_family_scale_is_so_narrow: The family arm is a sum of winsorize-then-standardize z-terms. Standardizing divides by
a standard deviation, and for heavy-tailed retrieval scores that standard deviation is
set by the tail, not by the bulk. p1/p99 winsorization per member does not fix it,
because the composite's heaviness comes from rows extreme on several members at once
and because 1% of rows still pass through at full magnitude.
The published cold family_z distribution is the signature of exactly this: p95 = +0.4607
but p99 = +9.46. Ninety-five percent of the cold population is compressed into a band
under one z wide while the top percentile is twenty times wider.
So the family's RANK information was intact -- that is why its lift was 1.83 -- while its
ARITHMETIC magnitude was a rounding error against the history arm. v1 measured real
discrimination and then had no shape that could spend it.

v1_own_words: 'The family is not too weak at the top: its best cold row reaches +10.16, well past the

The registered substitution imputes the arm's OWN median on the fitting split, by

rank_normal.formula: F(v) = clip(Phi_inverse(clip(u(v) + 0.5, 1/(2n), 1 - 1/(2n))), -3.0, +3.0), with u from the same construction as above

reason: A cold node cannot acquire delivery history at candidate time, and it cannot change its
level. Whatever those two arms say about it, it cannot answer. An arm a row cannot answer
must be able to REORDER rows but must not be able to put a row out of reach: that is the
arithmetic form of 'history informs, history does not gate', and breaking the
delivery -> history -> selection -> delivery loop is the root goal's stated purpose.
The candidate-time family is the opposite kind of evidence. It is what THIS retrieval
found about this node for THIS query -- evidence the row owns and can differ on. It is
therefore allowed to reach as far as the evidence warrants, and gets a normal-tailed
scale whose 99th percentile is +2.3263 and whose registered clip is +3.
This asymmetry is a pre-registered SCALE choice, fixed before any number from the
population was read, and derived from the stated principle above. It is not a coefficient
and it is not fitted. It is stated plainly here rather than buried, because a reviewer is
entitled to read it as a weight in disguise and judge the justification on its merits.
